title: AI Stock Losses Prompt Crackdown On Leveraged ETFs In South Korea
description: South Korean regulators freeze new single-stock leveraged tech ETFs and triple retail margin requirements after extreme "Roller KOSPI" volatility driven by retail AI bets decouples from Samsung and SK Hynix's stable earnings.

title: AI chatbot tip leads to arrest of Florida man on child abuse, pornography charges
description: Broward detectives said a tip from Grok, the AI chatbot built into X, prompted an investigation leading to the arrest of a 25-year-old Parkland man on child pornography charges.
